ValidationRule.description: Restrict Ex-Com Manager Edit on the Ex-Com Manager Approved Budgets
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Ex-Com Leadership", NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sales", OR( AND(ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"4th Level Approved")), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"3rd Level Approved") ), AND( NOT(ISCHANGED(Status__c)), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"3rd Level Approved") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have necessary permissions to edit the Budget.
